bio.text: Ted Eischeid is a Democratic member of the Alaska House of Representatives for District 22, serving in the 2025-2026 legislature.
According to the Alaska Legislature's member page, Eischeid was a middle school science teacher from 1990 to 2015 and a Matanuska-Susitna Borough municipal planner from 2017 to 2023.
The page lists a B.S. in fisheries and wildlife biology from Iowa State University, an M.S. in geoscience from Mississippi State University, and residence in Anchorage from 2016 to the present.
